arguments.content:
# On-policy Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT)
#
# Student: pi_theta(. | context)                       -- trainable
# Teacher: pi_0(. | context + expert turn in-context)  -- frozen base weights
# Loss:    per-token KL(student || teacher) on student rollouts

data:
  examples_path: data/examples.jsonl
  tools_path: configs/tools.json
  # Include the expert's <reasoning> in the in-context reference shown to the
  # teacher. Costs prompt tokens; usually the actions + text are enough.
  include_thinking_in_reference: false

model:
  name: Qwen/Qwen3-8B            # any HF causal LM with a chat template
  attn_implementation: sdpa      # flash_attention_2 if installed
  gradient_checkpointing: true
  lora:
    enabled: true                # with LoRA the teacher is the adapter-disabled
    r: 32                        # base model: zero extra weight memory
    alpha: 64
    dropout: 0.0                 # keep 0 so teacher == clean base distribution
    target_modules: [q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj]

distill:
  lambda_on_policy: 1.0          # fraction of examples scored on student rollouts
                                 # (the rest score the expert's own tokens — still
                                 # KL vs teacher, never plain cross-entropy)
  kind: reverse                  # reverse | forward | jsd
  jsd_beta: 0.5
  temperature: 1.0
  chunk_size: 128                # sequence-dim chunking for fp32 KL

rollout:
  max_new_tokens: 1024
  temperature: 0.8
  top_p: 0.95
  batch_size: 4                  # prompts per generate() call

limits:
  max_prompt_tokens: 6144        # applies to the (longer) teacher prompt
  max_seq_len: 8192              # prompt + response; responses truncated to fit
  min_response_tokens: 2

train:
  max_steps: 600
  batch_size: 8                  # examples per optimizer step (micro-batch = 1,
                                 # so this is also the grad-accumulation factor)
  lr: 1.0e-5
  weight_decay: 0.0
  warmup_steps: 20
  lr_scheduler: cosine
  max_grad_norm: 1.0
  seed: 17

chat_template_kwargs:
  enable_thinking: false         # drop for Qwen3-Instruct-2507+ / non-Qwen models

logging:
  log_every: 1
  save_every: 100
  output_dir: outputs/sdft-qwen3-8b
  wandb: false
  wandb_project: sdft
